quote: just finished DE'n 34 pairs of the pants, received 1 Greater Planar Essence, all the rest are arcane dust.
notes: First-person source explicitly disenchanted 34 Netherweave Pants: one yielded Greater Planar Essence and all remaining 33 outcomes were Arcane Dust (33 = 34-1, directly deduced from the explicit 'all the rest'). Total dust units per hit, actual dust stack distribution, exact date/build and skill unknown. Author calls it a nerf, but this is not an official documented hotfix and is not a verified rateChange.
